en.headline: Overnight slip-road closures on Central Kowloon Bypass
en.dek: Two Yau Ma Tei slip roads will shut from 12:30am to 5:30am on 8 to 10 October and again on 13 and 14 October.
body: The Transport Department said two slip roads on the Yau Ma Tei section of the Central Kowloon Bypass will close overnight for road works. The closures run from 12:30am to 5:30am on 8, 9 and 10 October, and again on 13 and 14 October.

The closed sections are the slip road from the Yau Ma Tei section of the bypass to the Western Harbour Crossing southbound, and the slip road from the same section to Lin Cheung Road northbound. All vehicles are barred from those slip roads during the stated hours.

Affected drivers heading for the Western Harbour Crossing southbound or Lin Cheung Road northbound will be diverted via Lin Cheung Road southbound, Jordan Road eastbound, Hoi Wang Road northbound and the Yau Ma Tei Interchange westbound. The department said signs would be placed on site. The notice was issued by the Commissioner for Transport, Tse Wing-yee.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道油麻地段支路連夜封閉
zh.dek: 兩條支路於10月8至10日及13至14日凌晨12時30分至上午5時30分禁止車輛駛入。
body: 運輸署公布，為配合道路工程，中九龍繞道油麻地段兩條支路將於深夜至清晨臨時封閉。封閉時間為10月8至10日，以及13至14日，每日凌晨12時30分至上午5時30分。
封閉路段為由中九龍繞道油麻地段通往西區海底隧道南行的支路，以及通往連翔道北行的支路。上述時段所有車輛不得駛入。
受影響、擬前往西區海底隧道南行或連翔道北行的車輛，須改經連翔道南行、佐敦道東行、海泓道北行及油麻地交匯處西行。署方表示現場會設置交通標誌。公告由運輸署署長謝詠誼發出。
